reviewedChanges.summary: Inspected all 17 failing comparison pairs from the actual 2161f3f CI artifact. Home/feed entry and menu navigation changes are expected. Other component pairs preserve their visible copy, images and controls. Six long-page comparisons were sampled at the changed entry/top, three 550px body bands and final 950px. Both 43-row attempts have the same 17 failures and 26 passes with identical comparison metrics. Exact caps and dimension reasons apply only to the bound bytes; no baseline, verifier, global threshold, workflow permissions or acceptance check was changed. This is assistant inspection, not independent-human approval or a release decision.

postCaptureChanges.scope: Capture metadata describes 2161f3f. Later browser execution must be checked on the final PR head; older successful cases do not substitute for that execution.

interactionEvidence.result: Chromium and Firefox feed steps passed 9 journeys each on 2161f3f. WebKit stopped at an immediate QR count before the asynchronous authoritative read completed; the final-head test now waits for QR visibility. Final-head WebKit execution is still required.

scopeLimits: Default Turkish Chromium visual captures at the configured viewports. These screenshots do not establish physical-device or every-language interaction correctness.
Long pages are sampled, not an OCR/pixel audit of every product.
Small edge/position changes are observations; attributing all of them to upstream reflow would be an inference.
The source workflow remains failed at the unrecorded visual delta; this record does not rewrite that historical result.
The existing verifier enforces file bindings and complete metric/dimension matching, not every metadata field.
reviewedChanges.freshEvidenceRule: Any rendering-byte or capture-toolchain change invalidates these bindings and requires fresh evidence. Only the exact complete 17-comparison failure set is accepted.
